name: 2.2.0 (Forge / NeoForge)
changelog:
2.2.0 — Security hardening of the no-hinting flags (recommended update); Forge and NeoForge now actually load and apply; the Java agent works under Fabric; detect mode keys on SHZ reachability; scanner fixes; the warning dialog's Continue button closes it.

2.2.0 — 加固关闭 hinting 的标志（建议更新）；Forge 与 NeoForge 现在真正生效；Java agent 在 Fabric 下可用；detect 模式改为按 SHZ 是否可达判断；修复扫描器问题；警告窗口的“继续”按钮可以正常关闭。
note: Forge/NeoForge 路徑尚未在真實 Forge 實例中載入過；若 loader 拒載，請改用 GitHub release 的 javaagent。
